caption: Each bar marks the firing window of one cylinder, drawn 60° wide only for visibility; the instant of the spark is the start of the bar. Coil 1&4 sparks at 0° (cylinder 1) and 360° (cylinder 4); coil 2&3 sparks at 180° (cylinder 3) and 540° (cylinder 2).

spec.aria: Timeline of one 720 degree cycle showing coil 1 and 4 firing at 0 and 360 degrees and coil 2 and 3 firing at 180 and 540 degrees, in firing order 1-3-4-2.
